page.content:
6 June 1944 Allied landings in Normandy.

How D-Day connects

  • Character: Dwight D. Eisenhower — Eisenhower commanded the Overlord landings.
  • Faction: Allies — D-Day was a British, American, and Canadian coalition landing.
  • Event: VE Day — VE Day closed the European war Overlord had reopened in the west.

What is D-Day?

D-Day — Operation Overlord — opened the long-promised western front. Eisenhower's coalition landed on five beaches and began the liberation of France.

Key threads lead to Dwight D. Eisenhower, Allies and VE Day.
